comparison_scope: New supplementary S1e probes only; not a claim that these development examples are unseen.
frame_end_convention: Exclusive end frames; bounds arrays are inclusive acceptable integer values for the corresponding start or exclusive end.

historical_fixture.note: The first four cases below are exact unchanged copies for historical reproducibility. Their historical expected fields do not override the supplementary scoring restrictions, especially the disputed push-up.

review_method: Independent source-frame contact-sheet inspection, with exact frame labels generated from each normalized 30fps input. Full source overviews and denser start/end samples were reviewed; a camera edit was localized with every-frame inspection. This reviewer did not successfully play the sources in a native/browser player. Coordinator playback confirmation must be recorded separately before live dispatch. Historical labels and results were not rewritten.
review_limitations: Development material already seen during prior experiments; not a held-out accuracy study.
Source-boundary extent means all available matching footage, not observation of the activity's natural onset or finish.
Preparation/follow-through endpoints allow the documented visual ambiguity, not neighboring different actions.
No Gemini calls were made by the independent reviewer.
The disputed push-up is not an admissible complete-move accuracy gate until cross-edit continuity and the complete move have been independently adjudicated.
Consumers must apply supplementary_reviews.scorable and the endpoint-probe contract; do not silently score copied/additional cases using historical expected fields alone.

supplementary_reviews.evidence: Frame0 already shows the same court activity. Frames0–119 and780–899 show the same players, net and court, with normal play/reset movements; full source overview shows ordinary pauses and resumption rather than an independently changed activity.
supplementary_reviews.uncertainty: No natural onset/finish is visible outside the source. The existing end tolerance is retained rather than widened. A pause alone is not a universal continuity rule.

supplementary_reviews.evidence: Frame0 is the opening standing preparation. Arms/feet open and close through frame78; frame80 is standing with arms down. Frame90 begins a downward bend and frames98–101 are floor-directed movement belonging to the next burpee.
supplementary_reviews.uncertainty: Opening preparation is source-clipped. The historical end tolerance75–86 is preserved; do not stretch through the bend to make a longer result.

supplementary_reviews.evidence: High side-view plank is visible575–615, descent around620–650, and low position through675–709. Every-frame review places last side-view frame709 and first front-view frame710. Front view remains low710–720, rises725–750, then shows high plank750–790. The historical description claiming a side-view rise completed by681–696 is contradicted by these observed frames.

Do not call frame710 a semantically late endpoint based only on the disputed historical end tolerance, and do not relabel it a complete-move pass.

supplementary_reviews.uncertainty: The source ends during boiling; neither natural onset nor finish is observed. Available extent610 frames supports a600-frame cut; this does not generalize to other requests or unseen footage.
